headline: ZOZO disclosed customer data exposure through PLAID’s KARTE platform, and Peach Aviation reported nearly nine million affected records in a separate vendor breach. Norway confirmed Microsoft Azure API Management exploitation in attacks that began earlier in the week.

incidents.what: ZOZO confirmed customer data exposure through KARTE. The ZOZOTOWN and WEAR counts may overlap; passwords and payment cards were not affected.
Peach disclosed that an October intrusion at email vendor Yumirulink affected customer records. Passport and card information was not involved.
Norway’s security authority said attackers exploited Azure API Management at Equinor and other organizations. It said the flaw had been fixed.
incidents.scale: Confirmed exploitation; no production impact reported at Equinor

incidents.what: Sales after a deployer-account compromise drove XMR1 down to about $1. Wagyu attributed the compromise to its hosting provider; the link has not been independently established.
incidents.scale: About $13.5M in sales, not a new loss this run

incidents.what: Bell disclosed theft of enterprise customer data. It did not disclose the initial access method or a victim count.
Fluidkey restored service and said a third-party logging tool exposed session data. It said user keys remained on their devices and a full post-mortem would follow.
incidents.scale: At least $1.58M in previously reported unauthorized payouts

incidents.what: The Icelandic hosting provider shut down services after a cyberattack and worked with CERT-IS. It did not confirm the scope of any data exposure.
Kurly reported that stolen credentials were used to access its systems and expose personal data belonging to participants in its affiliate program.
incidents.scale: 10,699 program participants; two other membership IDs

incidents.what: The operator said it took its service offline as a precaution after a cyberattack. Other FDJ United sites were also affected.
The ministry disclosed that its externally operated website was accessed without authorization and staff contact details were viewed.
In a downstream update on the PLAID KARTE breach, Recruit said Ring program data might have been exposed. It said payment information was not included.
Carnegie told donors that an intruder breached its online-donation vendor on October 28 and exposed some contact information.
